svg.title: Zava Banking: AI chat and support escalation
svg.desc: The banking web app reads and writes a SQL database in the Microsoft Fabric environment and exchanges prompts and replies with Azure OpenAI. Fabric Change Event Streaming sends committed escalation events through a CES event stream, which the Zava Support Web App consumes. Azure contains only Azure OpenAI.

text.tspan: Zava Banking | AI chat and support escalation
Fabric is the data and event environment. Azure hosts only Azure OpenAI.
Send question + SQL FAQ + conversation history
Chat response: read SQL context > call Azure OpenAI > save reply to SQL > return to the visitor
Important: the banking web app never publishes directly to the event stream.
Only committed ChatEscalations changes flow through Fabric CES; ordinary chat messages remain in SQL.
